evidence: culi highly recommends Cogito's West Papua documentary and praises its research and citations.

evidence_sources.author: culi
evidence_sources.excerpt: Cogito, who does some of the most astounding and in-depth research on global histories, just came out with an incredible documentary about the history of West Papua that changed the way I see it forever. I highly recommend it (and most of Cogito's work. Even his extensive citations are worth spending time with)

source_story_title: Tiny possum and glider thought extinct for 6000 years found in remote West Papua
